item: H1 - extension packaged and active in real Chrome and Edge
method: Each browser was launched fresh, the extension installed over CDP Extensions.loadUnpacked, and activation confirmed by finding a service_worker target whose URL carries the extension id. The install call returning an id proves the request was accepted; the running service worker proves it is active.

zeroTouch.note: An earlier pass concluded enterprise policy was the only route. That was wrong: CDP installs the extension with no policy change. It was also wrong that Edge refused the extension — that check compared against the CRX-signed id while an unpacked load derives its id from the path. manifest.json now pins its public key so both ids are the same value.
